method: Images downloaded for private visual inspection only. Images are NOT redistributed or used as textures. Models are original simplified geometry based on visible features.

models.name: 정문
models.observed: Two tall basalt-colored main piers and smaller outer piers. Horizontal lintels over side walkways, open central roadway, round emblems on inner piers, dol hareubang at the sides.
models.implemented: Paired stone piers, block joints, sidewalk lintels, circular emblems, simplified stone figures. No arch over main roadway.
models.uncertainty: Dimensions and exact pier offsets estimated from single photograph; geographic entrance node preserved.

models.name: 제주대학교 박물관
models.observed: Burgundy/purple stone wall panels, large horizontal blue-green glass curtain wall with dark mullions, projecting canopy, rounded vertical columns at ground and top, recessed glass entrance.
models.implemented: Burgundy footprint extrusion, broad curtain glazing and mullions on road-facing west facade, projecting roof strip and entrance canopy, vertical piers and dark glass entrance.
models.uncertainty: Height, proportions, exact entrance placement and unseen elevations are estimated. Existing OSM footprint unchanged.

models.name: 구본관
models.observed: Long beige facade with three visible window tiers, white vertical ribs, dark glazing, deep beige top fascia, central flat canopy on paired columns, broad staircase.
models.implemented: Beige cladding, repeated dark windows and white ribs, deep upper fascia, central columned canopy and broad steps. OSM footprint unchanged.
models.uncertainty: Historical appearance, not verified current. 2026 official admissions map labels this area former main building / planned AI convergence building. Window counts, rear elevations and dimensions are approximations.
